news.headline:
Physicswallah subsidiary FinZ Finance has entered an agreement to sell and transfer its loan portfolio aggregating to INR 95.8 crore to Auxilo Finserve. This major portfolio sale will result in a partial closure of FinZ Finance's lending operations.

The move aligns with Physicswallah's strategy to focus on core operations, optimize capital allocation, and reduce balance sheet risks by facilitating loans via third-party NBFCs. The transition is expected to conclude within the next 60 days.

Source: BSE

Sammaan Capital reported Q2FY27 disbursements of approximately ₹6,000 crore, up from ₹3,875 crore in Q1FY27. Its Assets Under Management grew to over ₹59,000 crore as of September 30, 2026, compared to ₹56,239 crore as of June 30, 2026.

The company added over 30,700 new customers during Q2FY27, compared to 11,867 in Q1FY27, while expanding its distribution footprint with its branch network reaching 245 branches.

Source: BSE

Sammaan Capital reported Q2FY27 disbursements of approximately ₹6,000 crore, up from ₹3,875 crore in Q1FY27. Its Assets Under Management grew to over ₹59,000 crore as of September 30, 2026, compared to ₹56,239 crore as of June 30, 2026.

The company added over 30,700 new customers during Q2FY27, compared to 11,867 in Q1FY27, while expanding its distribution footprint with its branch network reaching 245 branches.

Source: BSE

news.headline:
Vedanta reported a 5% growth in mined metal output to 2.8 lakh tonnes, alongside an almost 26% jump in ferrochrome production and a 16% rise in Copper India sales.

This operational update follows the demerger of the aluminium, iron, steel, and power businesses from Vedanta.

Source: ScoutQuest
